sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Strayer University-District of Columbia and Colorado State University Global differ significantly in ownership, enrollment, tuition, and location. Strayer University-District of Columbia is a private for-profit institution located in Washington, with an undergraduate enrollment of 156 students and an in-state tuition of $13,920. In contrast, Colorado State University Global is a public university based in Denver, serving 6,563 undergraduate students with a lower in-state tuition of $9,000. These distinctions highlight the differences in scale, governance, and cost between Strayer vs CSUGlobal.

These figures illustrate the differences in financial burden for students attending these two universities.
